message: Yay, Catullus! As a fellow classics-geek wannabe (I almost majored in classics, and one of the first courses I took was on Catullus and Horace), I applaud your choice of poems. #11 always impressed me with the way it juxtaposes the tragic "flower cut down by the plow" image -- which was originally an epic simile, wasn't it? I think I recall that from Latin class -- with that terrifically bad-tempered and penultimate stanza. I love how Catullus makes Latin seem like anything but a dead language. (For sheer gleeful potty-mouthedness, I think #16 has the edge over #11 -- but there are a lot of contenders for the "most potty-mouthed" category, aren't there?)
